# S20 — Overview rows: collapse setup errors, one line per row

Show a project without slicer once, as setup, not as errors under Needs
you and Running, and keep every Overview row to one line
(`ui.setup-errors`).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:** changes to the registry, `ork doctor`, or which projects are registered.

## Why

Each project with no `.slicer/` printed two wrapping errors, one for items
and one for relay runs, under both Needs you and Running, and counted
toward the badge (owner screenshot, 2026-10-19).

## Files

- `internal/tui/`, `testdata/golden/`, `docs/dashboard.md`.

## Failing tests

- A project whose slicer error has code `state` and a message starting
  "no .slicer/ found" (slicer has no code of its own for it) is dimmed in the
  sidebar as `no slicer`, appears in no Overview section, adds nothing to
  any count or to the bell, and its detail line gives the `slicer init`
  hint.
- Other errors: one row per project and error code, with the parts merged
  (`items, runs: locked`); the message is the tool's own text.
- Rows longer than the pane are cut with an ellipsis instead of wrapping;
  the selected row shows its full text on a detail line.
- Golden views for both cases.

- Decided in adj ui.overview-cursor (#84): the Overview has a row cursor (enter selects; project selection keeps its keys). Rows are cut with an ellipsis; run IDs are never clipped. The selected row shows its full text on a detail line, which keeps errors verbatim. Error rows never entered the badge; the no-slicer test stays as a regression guard. Keys documented in docs/dashboard.md.
